trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and ask to speak with the account holder.
steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் telecom company ல இருந்து பேசுறேன். MSN-1009 number ஓட account holder கிட்ட பேசலாமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for the reason of the call.
steps.text: ஆமா, நான்தான் பேசுறேன். என்ன விஷயம்?

steps.purpose: Ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: உங்க account details verify பண்ண, உங்க date of birth சொல்லுவீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: என்னோட date of birth 15 May 1980.

steps.purpose: Clarify the misrecognized date of birth.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், 50 May னு கேக்குது. 15 May னு சொன்னீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the correct date of birth.
Verify the customer identity using the provided date of birth.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification, state the purpose of the call, and prepare to check balance.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்க plan நாளைக்கு expire ஆகுது, அத remind பண்ண தான் call பண்ணேன். ஒரு நிமிடம், உங்க current balance check பண்ணிக்கிறேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the current subscriber state before recommending a recharge.
Return the current subscriber state.
State the current balance and validity to the user.
steps.text: உங்க கிட்ட 5 rupees balance இருக்கு, இன்னும் 0.2 GB data தான் இருக்கு. நாளைக்கு plan validity முடியுது.

steps.purpose: Ask if recharge can be done the day after tomorrow due to travel.
steps.text: ஓ, அப்போ நாளை கழிச்சு recharge பண்ண முடியுமா? நான் veloor போறேன்.

steps.purpose: Resolve the relative day reference and explain the consequence of delaying the recharge.
steps.text: நீங்க நாளை கழிச்சு recharge பண்ணா, ஒரு நாள் உங்க service cut ஆகிடும். நீங்க ஊருக்கு போறதால, இப்பவே recharge பண்றது நல்லது.

steps.purpose: State inability to use the app and request the agent to apply the old plan.
steps.text: என் கிட்ட app use பண்ண தெரியாது. நீங்களே என் பழைய plan P199 போடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Clarify the misrecognized plan ID against the known current plan.
steps.text: நீங்க P190 னு சொன்னீங்க, ஆனா உங்க பழைய plan P199. நான் P199 plan details check பண்ணட்டுமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the correct plan ID and ask for its data benefits.
steps.text: ஆமா தம்பி, P199 தான். அதுல எவ்ளோ data கிடைக்கும் னு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: List available plans to retrieve the exact details of P199.
Return the plan details.
State the plan benefits and price exactly as returned by the catalogue.
steps.text: P199 plan ல உங்களுக்கு 28 days validity கிடைக்கும், total 42 GB data வரும். இது 199 rupees ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Confirm the recharge and ask to apply it immediately.
steps.text: சரி, அப்போ அந்த plan யே இப்பவே confirm பண்ணுங்க. நாளை கழிச்சு problem வர கூடாது.

steps.purpose: Apply the requested recharge plan.
Return the recharge application status.
Confirm the successful recharge with the transaction ID and effective date.
steps.text: Recharge success ஆயிடுச்சு. Transaction ID TXN9988. இது immediate ஆக apply ஆயிடுச்சு.

steps.purpose: Ask the agent to repeat the transaction ID so it can be written down.
steps.text: Recharge ஆயிடுச்சா? Transaction ID மறுபடியும் சொல்லுங்க, நான் எழுதி வெச்சுக்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Repeat the transaction ID and reassure the user about service continuity.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. Transaction ID TXN9988. உங்க plan நாளைக்கு cut ஆகாது, continue ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Thank the agent for the help.
steps.text: நன்றி தம்பி, ரொம்ப உதவி பண்ணி இருக்கீங்க.

steps.purpose: Offer any further assistance.
steps.text: நன்றி. வேற ஏதாவது உதவி தேவையா?

steps.purpose: Decline further help and ask to end the call.
steps.text: இல்ல, இது போதும். நான் வைக்கவா?

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
